evidence.title: Clawvisor Launch Video
evidence.excerpt: Clawvisor is the authorization layer for AI agents. Approve a task once, and Clawvisor enforces it on every request — so your agent can use Gmail, Slack, and Google Drive without going rogue or ever seeing your credentials. ✅ No credential exposure — keys stay in a vault ✅ Real-time policy enforcement ✅ Context-aware guardrails ✅ Full audit trail ✅ Agent-agnostic (OpenClaw, Claude Code, Cowork, Hermes, Perplexity Computer) Get started → https://clawvisor.com Self-host or read the source →…
